question: Under what condition is even the wise person said to be burning in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence as an instrument.
Even the wise person, while burning, is in that condition.
inference: Even the wise person, burning, is affected in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The exact process and result of burning are not specified.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise person, while burning, also.
